{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mul_subexpression(
    input [7:0] multiplicand,
    input [7:0] multiplier,
    output [15:0] product
);
    wire [15:0] row [0:7];
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin: gen_rows
            assign row[i] = {8'b0, (multiplier & {8{multiplicand[i]}})} << i;
        end
    endgenerate

    wire [15:0] s10, c10, s11, c11;
    wire [15:0] s20, c20, s21, c21;
    wire [15:0] s30, c30, s40, c40;

    mul_subexpression_csa u10(row[0], row[1], row[2], s10, c10);
    mul_subexpression_csa u11(row[3], row[4], row[5], s11, c11);
    mul_subexpression_csa u20(s10, c10, s11, s20, c20);
    mul_subexpression_csa u21(c11, row[6], row[7], s21, c21);
    mul_subexpression_csa u30(s20, c20, s21, s30, c30);
    mul_subexpression_csa u40(s30, c30, c21, s40, c40);

    mul_subexpression_prefix_add u_final(s40, c40, product);
endmodule

module mul_subexpression_csa(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input [15:0] c,
    output [15:0] s,
    output [15:0] carry
);
    assign s = a ^ b ^ c;
    assign carry = ((a & b) | (a & c) | (b & c)) << 1;
endmodule

module mul_subexpression_prefix_add(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    output [15:0] s
);
    wire [15:0] p0, g0;
    wire [15:0] p1, g1;
    wire [15:0] p2, g2;
    wire [15:0] p3, g3;
    wire [15:0] p4, g4;
    assign p0 = a ^ b;
    assign g0 = a & b;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin: prefix
            if (k >= 1) begin: level1
                assign p1[k] = p0[k] & p0[k-1];
                assign g1[k] = g0[k] | (p0[k] & g0[k-1]);
            end else begin: pass1
                assign p1[k] = p0[k];
                assign g1[k] = g0[k];
            end
            if (k >= 2) begin: level2
                assign p2[k] = p1[k] & p1[k-2];
                assign g2[k] = g1[k] | (p1[k] & g1[k-2]);
            end else begin: pass2
                assign p2[k] = p1[k];
                assign g2[k] = g1[k];
            end
            if (k >= 4) begin: level3
                assign p3[k] = p2[k] & p2[k-4];
                assign g3[k] = g2[k] | (p2[k] & g2[k-4]);
            end else begin: pass3
                assign p3[k] = p2[k];
                assign g3[k] = g2[k];
            end
            if (k >= 8) begin: level4
                assign p4[k] = p3[k] & p3[k-8];
                assign g4[k] = g3[k] | (p3[k] & g3[k-8]);
            end else begin: pass4
                assign p4[k] = p3[k];
                assign g4[k] = g3[k];
            end
        end
    endgenerate
    assign s = p0 ^ {g4[14:0], 1'b0};
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original RTL serializes seven carry-propagating row additions. Its longest path can traverse multiple additions before reaching the upper product bits.",
  "rewrite": "Reduce the eight shifted partial-product rows through four carry-save levels, using six three-input compressors, followed by one explicit logarithmic-depth parallel-prefix carry-propagating adder. Constant and unused bits can be removed during synthesis.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to substantially reduce maximum arrival time by eliminating intermediate carry propagation. The exact SKY130HD timing improvement and electrical-rule compliance require the specified mapping and STA flow; no measured result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix adder adds parallel carry logic, while carry-save compression removes the repeated carry-propagating intermediate adders. Constant trimming should limit overhead, but the 3761.482560 um2 area cap and zero slew/capacitance violations remain to be verified by mapping.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the unsigned 8-bit inputs and 16-bit output, with no parameters, state, latency, or undefined outputs. Each compressor preserves its input sum modulo 65536, and the final adder also operates modulo 65536. The original shifted rows are reproduced exactly, so every product bit matches for all input combinations."
}
